meta.name: Searchable Operational List
meta.description: Search, filter, compare, select, and act on a server-backed collection while preserving state in the URL.

purpose: Enable users to locate and compare records efficiently, preserve search context, perform contextual or bulk actions, and navigate to detailed workflows.
useWhen: The dominant task is locating records in a medium or large collection.
Users need search, filters, sorting, or pagination.
Users compare several records before selecting one.
The collection supports contextual or bulk actions.
doNotUseWhen: The collection is very small, static, and requires no search.
The primary task is monitoring aggregated metrics.
The user primarily reviews one entity.
The workflow is a sequential creation process.

selectionQuestions: Which fields do users search most frequently?
Which filters must remain immediately visible?
Which columns are required for comparison?
Does the workflow require row selection or bulk actions?
How many records are typical and high volume?
Which state must be preserved in the URL?
What should happen when the user returns from a detail screen?

regions.name: Page Header
regions.role: Orient the user, describe the collection, and expose one primary collection-level action.
prohibitedComponents: Search input duplicated from the filter region
Several equally dominant creation and export actions

compact.layout: Stack title, description, and primary action.
compact.notes: Export and utilities move to overflow.

medium.layout: Title and actions wrap when required.

rules: The header normally contains one collection-level primary action.
Export and configuration are secondary or overflow actions.
The collection name uses user-facing terminology.

regions.name: Search and Filters
regions.role: Control server-backed search, filters, sorting scope, and active result criteria.
prohibitedComponents: Local state that diverges from URL state
regions.visibilityCondition: Always visible for this searchable-list recipe.

compact.notes: Active filter summary remains outside the drawer.

medium.layout: Search plus immediately useful filters; advanced filters in drawer.

wide.notes: Do not stretch all controls equally.

ultrawide.layout: Horizontal toolbar with constrained control widths and optional advanced-filter trigger.

rules: Search and filter state is validated from the URL.
Changing search or material filters resets pagination.
Text search cancels stale requests.
Clear-all behavior is explicit.
Filter scope matches request parameters.

regions.name: Active Filter Summary
regions.role: Make the current result scope visible and allow users to remove active criteria.
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when one or more non-default filters are active.

compact.placement: Below the search and filter controls.
compact.layout: Wrapping filter chips and clear-all action.
compact.notes: Do not require reopening the drawer to understand active scope.

medium.notes: Long filter values may truncate with accessible full text.

ultrawide.notes: Do not create a horizontal chip scroller.

rules: Default filters do not appear as active chips unless product context requires it.
Removing a filter updates the URL and query.
Clear-all preserves mandatory scope such as tenant context.

regions.name: Bulk Actions
regions.role: Present actions that apply to the current explicit selection.
prohibitedComponents: Bulk action without explicit selection count

sticky.compactBehavior: Render a compact sticky selection bar or bottom action surface.

regions.visibilityCondition: Visible only when one or more rows are selected and the user has an eligible capability.

compact.placement: Sticky compact action bar associated with selected results.
compact.layout: Selection count, one primary bulk action, overflow for secondary actions.
compact.notes: Do not obscure pagination or essential content.

ultrawide.notes: Do not expand action spacing unnecessarily.

rules: Selection count is explicit.
Selection is cleared or reconciled when filters materially change.
Bulk destructive actions use confirmation and permission checks.
The backend remains authoritative for eligibility.

regions.name: Results Summary
regions.role: Communicate result count, current range, sorting context, and refresh state.
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when the query has completed successfully.

compact.layout: Wrap result count and compact sort control.
compact.notes: Column controls may move to overflow.

wide.notes: Do not compete with the page header.

rules: Result count distinguishes total records from current page range.
Background refresh does not erase existing result context.
Sort labels are user-facing.

regions.name: Results
regions.role: Present records in a comparison-oriented table, list, or master-detail structure.
prohibitedComponents: Page-local table implementation when a canonical DataTable exists
Every backend field as a column

scroll.notes: Controlled horizontal scrolling is allowed when column comparison remains the correct compact pattern.

regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when successful query data contains records.

compact.layout: Reduced-column table, summary list, or master-detail trigger according to approved screen contract.
compact.notes: Do not automatically convert all tables into cards.

medium.layout: Table with prioritized columns and controlled horizontal overflow.
medium.notes: Sticky header may be used within the correct scroll owner.

ultrawide.layout: Full operational data table with optional persistent contextual details.
ultrawide.notes: Do not add low-value columns merely to fill width.

rules: Columns are selected according to comparison needs.
Row actions remain secondary to row content.
Selection controls have accessible labels.
Clicking a row must not conflict with interactive cells.
Long critical values remain accessible.

regions.name: Pagination
regions.role: Navigate the server-backed result collection while preserving filters and sorting.
prohibitedComponents: Pagination state disconnected from the URL
regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when the collection exceeds one page or page-size control remains relevant.

compact.layout: Compact previous, range, and next controls.

medium.layout: Range, page navigation, and page-size control.

ultrawide.notes: Do not detach pagination visually from the results.

rules: Page and page size are validated.
Changing page size resets to a valid page.
Returning from details restores list context where product requirements support it.

regions.name: Contextual Details
regions.role: Provide optional preview or selected-record context without replacing the full entity-detail route.

sticky.compactBehavior: Open as a modal drawer or navigate to the detail route.

regions.visibilityCondition: Visible when the approved workflow supports previewing a selected result.

compact.notes: Do not leave the results region unusably narrow.

wide.notes: Use persistent aside only when comparison benefits.

ultrawide.notes: Do not expand the aside excessively.

rules: Preview content is a curated subset.
The full detail route remains authoritative for complete workflows.
Selection state is explicit and keyboard accessible.
Closing the overlay restores focus.

composition.columnPolicy: Single primary results column with optional contextual details aside or overlay.
spacingOwnership: The recipe owns gaps between page header, filters, results summary, results, and pagination.
The filter bar owns control gaps.
The DataTable owns cell and row spacing.
Pagination owns spacing between navigation controls.
surfacePolicy: Filters may use a subtle surface.
Results use one coherent data surface.
Do not wrap each row in an independent card unless the approved compact pattern is a list.
Contextual details use an elevated surface.
composition.scrollOwner: application content canvas with optional internal horizontal results scrolling
rules: Search and filters precede results.
Bulk actions appear only after explicit selection.
Results and pagination remain visually connected when pagination is present.
Optional contextual detail does not replace the full detail workflow.
prohibited: Every backend field rendered as a column.
Filters stored only in transient component state.

actions.primaryPlacement: Page header for create or collection-level primary action.
actions.secondaryPlacement: Page header overflow, result utilities, or selected-record context.
actions.destructivePlacement: Row or bulk workflow with explicit confirmation and permission context.
actions.bulkPlacement: Bulk action toolbar visible only for explicit selection.
actions.contextualPlacement: Row action menu or contextual details panel.
actions.overflowPolicy: Export, column configuration, and low-frequency utilities move to overflow.
actions.compactBehavior: Keep one collection-level primary action and move utility or secondary actions to overflow.
rules: Row actions do not visually dominate row content.
Bulk actions display selection count.
Clicking a row must not accidentally invoke an action when interacting with controls.

content.headingPolicy: One h1 in the page header; results and optional contextual details use labeled regions.
content.longContentPolicy: Column and list content follows explicit wrapping, truncation, and full-value access rules.
content.truncationPolicy: Critical comparison values remain visible; secondary metadata may truncate with accessible full text.
content.emptyStatePlacement: Replace the results region, not the complete page header and filter context.
content.loadingStrategy: Use table or list skeletons for initial loading and preserve existing data during background requests.
content.errorScope: Search or results errors affect the results region; authentication and permission failures may affect the route.
rules: No-results state preserves active filters and offers adjustment.
Empty collection state may offer the primary creation action.
Result counts distinguish total and current range.
Dates, currency, and statuses use centralized formatting.

responsive.minimumViewport: 320 CSS pixels with approved reduced-column or list representation.
responsive.zoomExpectation: The list must remain operable at 125% browser zoom.
responsive.internalOverflowPolicy: The results region may own controlled horizontal scrolling when table comparison remains appropriate.

transformations.change: Remove low-priority columns or switch persistent preview to an optional drawer before compressing essential columns.
Move advanced filters to a drawer, reduce table columns, and use controlled horizontal scrolling.
transformations.reason: Maintain search efficiency and essential comparison.

transformations.change: Use search plus filter drawer, compact result summary, reduced-column table or approved list pattern, and compact pagination when pagination is present.
transformations.reason: Compact viewports cannot display full filters and wide result tables simultaneously.

states.rendering: Render stable result skeletons while preserving the page header and filter structure.
Preserve current results and communicate that the new query is loading.
states.userAction: Continue reviewing current data or wait.

states.rendering: Render result summary, data table or list, conditionally applicable pagination, and eligible actions.
states.userAction: Search, compare, select, act, or open details.

states.rendering: Explain that the collection contains no records in the current base scope.
states.userAction: Create, import, configure, or return according to product context.

states.rendering: Preserve search and filters, explain that no records match, and expose filter-adjustment actions.
states.userAction: Change search, remove filters, or clear all.

states.rendering: Render a result-region recovery state without removing the user's search criteria.
Render the approved permission state or redirect according to disclosure policy.
Keep current results with a visible freshness indication when they remain useful.

landmarkMap: Page content uses the inherited main landmark.
Search and filters use a labeled form.
Results use a labeled section or table region.
Pagination uses a labeled navigation landmark when present.
Contextual details use an aside or dialog according to presentation.
headingStructure: Results require an accessible region label even when no visible h2 is necessary.
Contextual details use a nested heading.
focusOrder: Page header and primary collection action.
keyboard: Search, filters, sorting, pagination when present, selection, and row actions are keyboard operable.
Contextual drawers trap and restore focus.
Selection controls have row-specific accessible names.
announcements: Material result-count changes should be perceivable without announcing every keystroke.
Bulk selection count changes should be available to assistive technology.
Loading and error states must be associated with the results region.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Status, selection, sorting, and validation do not depend only on color.
rules: Do not use clickable table rows without preserving keyboard and nested-control behavior.
Pagination controls require accessible labels when rendered.
Hidden compact columns must not leave orphaned header associations.

prohibitedPatterns: Every DTO field rendered as a column.
Infinite scrolling without approved task rationale.
Pagination rendered only because the recipe contains a pagination region.
dataMagnitude: The collection may contain thousands or tens of thousands of server-backed records.
Names, identifiers, and statuses may contain long localized values.
The visible page represents only a subset of the collection.
performance: Use server pagination for large collections.
Avoid rerendering the entire table for unrelated toolbar state.
Use virtualization only when measured or required.
implementation: URL search parameters own shareable filters, sorting, and pagination.
Query keys include every response-shaping parameter.
Formatting and enum presentation use centralized mappings.
Machine presence conditions come from presenceDefaults; visibilityCondition prose is explanatory only.

presenceDefaults.rationale: The collection route always needs orientation and its collection-level action context.
Search/filter control is structural to the searchable-list recipe.
Do not reserve space for active-filter presentation when the effective filter set is default.
Bulk actions exist only for an explicit actionable selection.
Result summary belongs to a successfully evaluated query state.
The results surface must collapse in empty and no-results states.
A one-page collection must not render pagination chrome unless page-size control remains a real user decision.
Preview context requires both a selected record and an approved preview capability.

checks.description: The searchable-list recipe must validate against the layout recipe schema.
checks.remediation: Correct missing or invalid recipe fields.

checks.description: Search, filters, sorting, page, and page size must remain synchronized with validated URL state.
checks.remediation: Correct URL parsing, normalization, or query-key construction.

checks.description: The page must not introduce horizontal overflow outside the approved results scroll region.
checks.remediation: Correct table width, column policy, or responsive transformation.

checks.description: Empty collection and no-results states must remain semantically distinct.
checks.remediation: Provide separate content and next actions.

checks.description: Row selection, sorting, pagination when present, and contextual actions must be keyboard operable.
checks.remediation: Correct DataTable semantics and control labeling.

checks.description: Pagination and other conditional regions must follow presenceDefaults rather than region existence or explanatory prose.
checks.remediation: Bind rendered presence to the typed condition signal and keep conditional regions cardinality-minimum zero.
